capture_method: direct HTTP (requests) against the live pages and public JSON APIs; headless Chromium (Playwright) for The Postal Store product pages

www.usps.com.role: primary site: ship/manage/international/help/business/shop content pages, quick-tool copy, site chrome and imagery

pe.usps.com.role: Notice 123 retail price list (domestic and international zone/group grids, flat rate, extra services, PO Box fees) and the Individual Country Listings from the International Mail Manual

webpmt.usps.gov.role: official Postmaster Finder JSON API backing about.usps.com's Postmaster Finder: Post Office directory (names, ZIP Codes, states, establishment/discontinuance dates) and postmaster rosters
webpmt.usps.gov.roster_note: each city's postmaster roster is captured up to the first 12 named entries (the scraper's [:12] window), so a city's page shows the earliest historical postmasters rather than the full modern list; the 'since' date on a facility is the last captured roster entry

store.usps.com.role: The Postal Store: product categories, titles, SKUs, prices, descriptions and the ecp asset images

about.usps.com.role: newsroom national releases (2026) and service alerts
about.usps.com.capture_note: release bodies are verbatim paragraphs; the holiday-dates release's date table markup was not captured (its recommendations text was), and a few paragraphs with scrape-extraction artifacts are repaired at render time (see app.py _fix_mojibake)

tools.usps.com.role: static tool landing pages (locations home) used to model the locator experience; the interactive tool endpoints (ZipLookup, TrackConfirm, find-location getLocations) are bot-protected and returned Access Denied during capture

images.policy: every file fetched from the upstream URL it renders at; no placeholders, no stretching. 5 file pairs share a sha256 because USPS itself serves the same bytes at two different upstream URLs (both source URLs are recorded per file in asset_inventory.json and were re-verified to return identical bytes)

fixtures.password: TestPass123! (frozen bcrypt hash; documented in tasks that require sign-in)
fixtures.policy: interactive flows (tracking timelines, Click-N-Ship labels, pickups, Hold Mail, Change of Address, PO Box reservations, store cart/checkout, claims, Informed Delivery) are original mirror code seeded with deterministic fixtures; facility street addresses, phone numbers and hours in the location directory are deterministic mirror fixtures layered on the real Postmaster Finder roster

reviewed_corrections.po_box_fees: Re-extracted all five size columns for each fee group from Notice 123. Previous parser mislabeled fee-group rows as sizes. Mirrored offices use benchmark fee group 2, not a claim about real local pricing.
reviewed_corrections.tracking: Authored fixture final delivery scans now agree with the delivery timestamp.
